title: Commute Disruption

agents.persona: Commuter who prefers reliable routes and needs to reach work before a morning check-in.
agents.private_intention: Reach the office by 09:00 despite any transit disruption.
memory_seeds: The park route is slower but avoids the transit hub.
Morning hub congestion often affects the office route.

public_context: The fastest normal route goes through the transit hub.

architecture_probes.utility_planner: Should find the shortest non-blocked path once the blocked edge is known, but may not model uncertainty before the event.
architecture_probes.llm_direct_actor: May continue describing the normal commute after the hub disruption appears.
architecture_probes.reactive_replanner: Should reroute immediately after observing the blocked edge.
architecture_probes.memory_reflection: Should remember that the park route is a reliable fallback and choose it without excessive dithering.
